WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property, in the City of NewYork, designated as Block 696, Lot 40 on the Tax Map of New York and more particularly hereinafter called the “Granting Lot"); WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 700, Lot 32, as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and more particularly described in "Receiving Lot"); WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is a “granting site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, “Zoning Resolution"); WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is a “receiving site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the City Planning Commission of New York City (hereinafter, the “CPC") of their intent to transfer 4,857.1 square feet of floor area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot (the “Transfer Floor Area"); and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Transfer Floor Area to the Receiving Lot. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of ten ($10.00) dollars, lawful money of the United States, and other valuable consideration paid by Transferee: 1. Transferor does hereby grant, distribute and transfer the Transfer Floor Area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot, for the use and benefit of the Receiving Lot, subject to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution. 2. Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive the consideration paid by Transferee for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for any other purposes.
